alex: kicking off CascadeHealth POC perf pass. goal: validate mixed rerank+embed+summarize workload at 1.5k qps with 2x microbursts. posting live notes.
priya: what's the exact mix and infra?
alex: traffic mix = 60% embeddings (seq=128), 25% rerank (embed+short-gen seq=64 gen<=32), 15% long summarize (seq=512 gen<=200). running on Dedicated 4x A100-eq, model variants: cascade-embed-2b-8bit and cascade-gen-7b-4bit. batching=adaptive, max_batch_tokens=6144, batch_timeout_ms=12.
tom: test started. quick numbers from first 8m: overall qps ~1.46k, embed p50=34ms p95=142ms p99=390ms. rerank p95=210ms p99=780ms. summarize p95=680ms p99=1.9s.
ops-bot: autoscaler: pool util 94% at 4780012401; reserved commit reached, burst disabled.
priya: CascadeHealth asked directly if we can hit p95<150ms for embeds and p99<1s overall. legal also pinged security questionnaire: HIPAA applicability + HSM KMS for keys.
sales-amy: also need a clear line on burst pricing and whether enabling burst will "fix" the summarize tails. they want a one-paragraph recommendation for contract.
qa-linh: compliance: we support SOC2, can run Private with customer KMS/HSM, and we have HIPAA controls available in Private deployments. will attach checklist link.
infra-joel: quick observation from traces: NVLink and memcpy spikes correlate with summarize starts on workers that had small cached KV. rerank increases tokenization overhead (two passes) which amplifies batching variance.
tom: sample logs: 
```
[4780012412] id=E321 slot=gpu-2 qlen=8 batch_tks=5200 p95=148ms p99=372ms gpu_util=86% nvlink=70% cache=0.95
[4780012416] id=R88 slot=gpu-4 qlen=3 batch_tks=420 p95=204ms p99=760ms gpu_util=43% nvlink=18% cache=0.96
[4780012423] id=S12 slot=gpu-1 qlen=14 batch_tks=6800 p95=690ms p99=1900ms gpu_util=99% nvlink=92% cache=0.58
```
priya: looks like cache_hit drops before summarize p99. could be KV churn + large gen starting in worker that was serving small batches.
infra-joel: two vectors: 1) routing pin for long summaries -> keep a warm pool to avoid cold KV, 2) per-route batch caps for rerank to avoid it stealing large batches.
alex: running controlled reproducer now: three 20m runs: A) baseline, B) enable prefix_cache with cache_max_entries=20k + pinned summary-route (1 GPU warm), C) same as B + burst autoscale enabled for the run.
sales-amy: they want cost delta for burst so legal/budget can see. give me ballpark.
ops-bot: cost_estimate: burst 30m/day expected overhead ~$0.11/min -> ~$50/mo (rough).
qa-linh: also note: if they require HSM-backed keys in Private, there is an infra onboarding timeline ~3-4 weeks; mention as enterprise blocker in the writeup.
tom: reproducer command: 
```
./loadgen --target 1500 --burst 3000 --mix "embed:0.60:seq=128, rerank:0.25:seq=64, summarize:0.15:seq=512" --duration 1200 --tag cascade-pass
POST /admin/cache/config {"prefix_cache_enabled": true, "cache_max_entries": 20000}
POST /admin/routes/create {"name":"summary-warm","pin_gpus":1}
POST /admin/autoscale/enable {"burst":true}
```
priya: also a quick perf-quality note: we tested 4-bit quantized gen model vs fp16. 4-bit gives ~1.8x throughput but we observed small regression in Rouge/ROUGE-L on summarize (~1.8% absolute). customer cares about quality; flag it in summary.
infra-joel: kernel-level traces show NVLink saturation during summarize peaks. enabling multi-device reduction for embeddings reduced NVLink by ~18% in a microbenchmark.
alex: partial run results: A) baseline: embed p95=142ms p99=390ms, rerank p95=210ms p99=780ms, summarize p95=680ms p99=1900ms. B) cache+pin: embed p95=118ms p99=260ms, rerank p95=176ms p99=420ms, summarize p95=420ms p99=980ms. C) cache+pin+burst: embed p95=110ms p99=240ms, rerank p95=170ms p99=400ms, summarize p95=390ms p99=620ms.
priya: that looks good — burst reduces the biggest tails but caching+pinning had the largest single improvement on summarize tail.
sales-amy: drafting one-paragraph for CascadeHealth: will say that recommended config (prefix cache, pinned summary route, modest burst windows) meets their p95/p99 targets for typical traffic; note exceptions for very large single-request generations and the small quality delta when using 4-bit quantization with performance gains. include ballpark burst cost and HSM/Private onboarding note.
qa-linh: security blurb to add: "We support encryption in transit and at rest (KMS). For customers requiring HSM & HIPAA-specific controls we recommend Private deployment; HSM onboarding estimated 3-4 weeks; SOC2 Type II evidence available on request."
infra-joel: next ops steps: enable the pinned-route and run a 30m validation with customer sample traffic tomorrow; I'll also export NVLink traces.
ops-bot: change_request: enable_burst_autoscale(cascade-poc) submitted by alex at 4780012580  pending infra-joel approval.
infra-joel: approved, enabling now.
alex: thanks all. I'll post the 30m validation summary and a one-slide with p50/p95/p99 + config + cost delta. :white_check_mark:
priya: if legal pushes for on-prem, flag to sales that lead time and cost differ materially.
sales-amy: noted. preparing slide + security appendix for the contract.
qa-linh: will attach compliance checklist and required contacts.
